question: Which edition of Indian Air Force Day is celebrated in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**93rd.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Indian Air Force Day 2025 marks the 93rd anniversary of the founding of the Indian Air Force (IAF) in 1932.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Air Force was officially established on October 8, 1932, under British rule, with just three aircraft and six officers.**
 
• **The IAF's motto, “Nabha Sparsham Deeptam,” means “Touch the Sky with Glory,” taken from the Bhagavad Gita, reflecting its courage and dedication.**
 
• **IAF Day is celebrated annually on October 8 to honor the brave officers and personnel of the Air Force and their contributions to national security.**
 
• **The 93rd edition in 2025 marks a major milestone in the IAF's history, showcasing its growth and modernization over nearly a century.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Air Force (IAF)__

 __
 
• India’s air warfare and defense branch, established in 1932, plays a crucial role in the country’s security and peacekeeping efforts.
 
 
 
• IAF Motto__
 
 
• "Nabha Sparsham Deeptam," which symbolizes the Air Force's commitment to reaching new heights in service to the nation.
